# ControlTheoreticNetworkTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The application of control theory principles (e.g., feedback, stability, observability) to the design and real-time adjustment of network topology. Provides a formal methodology for ensuring robust and predictable behavior in topology-centric computing architectures under dynamic workloads.
